title: Verdict
description: Machine-readable object emitted by the `coordinator_agent` at the end of every `coordination_turn` (ADR-002, ADR-005, §2.5). Runtime handling of each `next_action` value is specified in §4.4 — not in this schema.

next_action.description: Coordinator semantic intent. CLOSED enum of exactly four values (ADR-002, §2.5).

confidence.description: Coordinator's confidence in the round's deliberation, 0.0 to 1.0 inclusive (Pass 1 row #59d).

focus.description: Brief directive for the next round (semantic hint). Runtime treatment in §4.4.

next_agents.description: Coordinator's advisory agent preference for the next round. Runtime treatment in §4.2.

resolved_disagreements.description: Disagreements the Coordinator considers settled in this round, each with rationale. Carried forward for inclusion in synthesis (M5).

resolution.description: How the panel settled it (citation, fact, vote, etc.).

agents_involved.description: Optional list of agent ids that held the original positions.

unresolved_disagreements.description: Disagreements the panel did not reconcile this round. Carried forward into synthesis or termination_artifact (M5).

blocker.description: True if this disagreement is a blocker for `finalize`.

user_input_request.description: Structured payload describing the information needed from the originator. Present only when `next_action = request_user_input` (§4.4). Required fields are intentionally minimal in MVP; richer sub-schemas are deferred to v1.

context.description: Optional context the originator needs to answer.

blocking.description: True if the deliberation cannot proceed without this input. Runtime treatment in §4.4.

external_research_request.description: Structured payload describing the external research action requested. Present only when `next_action = request_external_research` (§4.4). Sub-schemas for specific research types (web, retrieval, tool-augmented agent) are deferred to v1.

rationale.description: Why the research is needed (separate from the verdict-level `rationale` for completeness).
